pages.title: Computronium Lamp
pages.text: A computronium block lit from within by glowstone, its traces brightened into a steady, warm glow. It looks like a terminal screen turned into a lamp. The light pulses almost imperceptibly, a slow rhythm like breathing. Close up, the traces under the glow are still busy rearranging themselves.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Computronium's own glow was too faint to read by. Adding glowstone dust turned a block into a proper lamp that still hums with computation.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Superintelligence.
